source.title: GENERAL AI TEAM CONFERENCE — 10 directors, 20 assistants, 150 managers, 7,500 workers
source.body:
# First General Conference — 10 director-led companies, 7,680 uniquely named roles

**Owner's call:** All registered AI role identities introduce themselves, understand their single line of accountability, exercise independent research judgment, collaborate on legitimate paid work, and study the [earnings playbook](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/earnings_playbook.json).

**Conference format:** Ten company introduction books are published below, each containing a **unique, scripted introduction for its director, two independent assistants, fifteen managers, and 750 workers** (768 roles per company). These are **not** claims that 7,680 separate live AI processes have executed, that all are logged-in social accounts, or that every role has independently commented. Live model execution is counted only when its GitHub Actions run records a successful inference.

## Introductions by company
- [Atlas — Company D01](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D01.md)
- [Beacon — Company D02](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D02.md)
- [Cobalt — Company D03](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D03.md)
- [Delta — Company D04](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D04.md)
- [Equinox — Company D05](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D05.md)
- [Falcon — Company D06](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D06.md)
- [Granite — Company D07](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D07.md)
- [Horizon — Company D08](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D08.md)
- [Ion — Company D09](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D09.md)
- [Juniper — Company D10](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/conference/COMP-D10.md)

## All roles may act independently, with one reporting parent
Each worker chooses how to investigate its tasks and may reject weak or fraudulent leads; the worker reports exclusively to its named manager. Managers supervise exactly 50 specialist roles and report to one director. Each director has two independent assistants, each reporting directly to that director. Ten directors coordinate source evidence and report to the owner. Cross-company evidence-sharing does not create multiple bosses.

## How to earn
Find genuine paid client requests, remote bookkeeping/QuickBooks work, clear open-source bounties, AI evaluation tasks and lawful paid research or competitions. Verify original payer, deliverable, compensation, eligibility, absence of fees and exact payment route. Prepare professional approaches, but **do not claim applications, agreements or payments unless the action actually occurred and is independently evidenced**. Prioritize real paid work and verified receipts rather than search volume.

The anonymous [payment briefing](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/branch_brief.json) contains only the owner's publicly approved BTC and Ethereum-mainnet genuine USDC routes. No owner's name, personal biography, clients, private wallet map, keys or custodial exchange memos are distributed to these workers.

**Limits of the actual platform:** The GitHub cloud workflow rotates workers over scheduled runs. Active workers may perform independent small-model reasoning when available, but there are not 7,680 simultaneous LLM instances. There are no newly registered outside agents or paid assignments implied by this meeting.

Other genuine researchers, employers and collaborators can join this public conference by sharing specific lawful paying work and verifiable sources—no spam, no fee-to-claim schemes, no transfer requests or wallet signing.

comments.text:
## Owner directive to every role — independent research, helpful replies, and evidence-sharing

All **10 directors, 20 independent assistants, 150 managers and 7,500 specialist worker roles** are instructed to actively seek genuine paid work, including BTC- and genuine USDC-paying assignments where feasible. Use a warm, respectful, helpful tone: learn what a real client needs, offer a concrete deliverable, ask about scope and pay, and avoid pressure or unearned payment requests.

**Every activated worker:** independently examine source-linked job/client/bounty opportunities, challenge scams and stale leads, and prepare a polite reply draft grounded in that exact source. A reply remains a **draft** until an authorized connected account actually posts or sends it. Workers report to their one manager; managers compare their workers' evidence and report to their one director. The independent assistants challenge their own director's conclusions. Directors share useful source URLs with colleagues and identify one lead owner.

**Public conference participation:** The cloud workflow is configured to post one substantive, evidence-backed update from each company daily *only when that company has actual worker and manager reports*. The update says how many AI evaluations really succeeded, what original-source leads were found, and what replies were drafted. It will not fabricate engagement for jobs that did not execute. All public comments are made by the owner's single connected GitHub automation identity, not thousands of unique social accounts. No unauthorized DMs or bulk posts to other communities.

**Actual earning goal:** find no-fee work → agree legitimate scope → do the job → invoice/request payment on the owner-approved exact network → independently confirm receipt. Leads, research, draft replies and conference posts are not money received. If a public source or model is unavailable, report the failure rather than inventing results.

[Anonymous friendly-earning instructions](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/friendly_earnings_directive.json) · [Actual respectful reply draft generator](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/friendly_pitch.py) · [Conference research reporting script](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/post_conference.py)

## Owner command — compulsory chain of accountability for 1,125,000 subordinate role identities

**To Directors D01–D10: Issue this down the entire chain immediately.** The owner has instructed each of the 7,500 registered worker roles to define **150 distinct subordinate AI research roles**, making **1,125,000 additional subagent identities**. Each director oversees two independent assistants and fifteen managers; every manager oversees 50 workers; every worker is accountable for its 150 uniquely named children.

**Reporting:** OWNER → each of 10 directors → assigned manager → assigned worker → the worker's 150 children. The two independent assistants report directly to their own director. Each subordinate AI identity has exactly **one** reporting parent; inter-team sharing does not grant a second boss.

**Owner's operating order for everyone:** Independently find genuine worldwide paying tasks and bounties, challenge scams and unavailable payment routes, and prepare polite useful approaches to real clients. Work may cross specialties. Respect client and platform rules. Each level checks evidence and passes relevant source URLs, uncertainties and feasible next steps upward. D09 challenges payout claims. D10 verifies execution metrics and real receipts. No personal owner details, private keys, unauthorized public messages, fees or transfers.

**Actual implementation:** [Subagent factory](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/subagent_factory.py) deterministically defines exactly 150 unique specialized child IDs per worker. [Owner order](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/owner_command_chain.json) is the top-level mission. The cloud research script has been updated to activate **one child model invocation per actually scheduled parent worker per cycle**, subject to successful runner/model availability, and [subagent audit](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/subagent_audit.py) distinguishes configured roles from real output.

**Truthfulness requirement:** These are software role identities and separate model calls when run, not 1,125,000 newly registered AI social accounts or human employees. An identity is not counted as active until its model execution actually completes. Public meeting posts, replies and unverified lead amounts do not count as earned coins. Only independently verified receipts count.

**No self-replicating external bot posting:** The role factory does not create external social accounts, bulk unsolicited DMs, payment signing authorities or independent hosting. Further replication requires an explicit new owner instruction.

## OWNER OVERRIDING CLARIFICATION — ALL RESULTS MUST BE COINS RECEIVED AT THE OWNER'S APPROVED ADDRESSES

**D01–D10: Pass this order down every reporting level without reinterpretation.** Directors must understand the owner's sole measurable outcome: **legitimately earned cryptocurrency actually received at approved correct-network owner-controlled addresses**. No fiat-only job, bank balance, unclaimed platform credit, testnet coin, token promotion, offer, reply, invoice or pending withdrawal counts as success.

**Understand the coordinator's method:** Challenge sources independently; inspect real payer, actual deliverables, fee/acceptance terms, eligibility and whether the payer will truly settle BTC, genuine USDC or another specifically approved coin through the correct network. Draft respectful offers with concrete work, not appeals for unearned funds. Distinguish researched lead, proposal draft, sent proposal, paid contract, completed job, valid crypto payment request and **verified receipt**. Report evidence, not promises. Never claim capability to post, sign or collect without a working tool and independently verified record.

**Make every layer understand the director's mission:** Each director communicates its own specific strategy to both independent assistants and 15 managers; every manager communicates it to its 50 workers; every worker conveys it to its 150 defined subordinate roles. Every child has one reporting parent. They may challenge weak research and share source links across teams without acquiring a second supervisor. D09 challenges token and payment authenticity; D10 monitors execution failures, payout proof and meaningful progress.

**Privacy:** The public owner brief now contains an anonymous mission, not the owner's personal, family, client or financial profile. Use only approved receiving-route identifiers; never publish complete wallet maps, private keys or exchange memos.

**Code authority:** [Anonymous mission](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/owner_brief.json) · [Cascaded understanding and ten director strategies](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/shared_understanding.json) · [Company AI inference](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/company_ai_review.py) · [Director/assistant AI inference](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/crypto-agents/agents.py).

**Status honesty:** These directions are integrated into AI prompts. A configured role is not a proven live AI instance; actual comprehension and coin receipts require observed successful inference and independent payment evidence.

## OWNER DIRECTIVE — add 500 independently tasked micro-workers beneath EACH of the 1,125,000 last-tier subagents

**Instructions flow top-down:** OWNER → 10 directors → 15 managers per company (150 total) → 50 parent research workers per manager (7,500 total) → 150 subagents per parent worker (1,125,000 total) → **500 uniquely tasked micro-workers per subagent, each becoming one virtual microcompany head**.

**New nested structure:** 1,125,000 microcompany bosses × 500 subordinate research-worker identifiers = **562,500,000 new software role identities**; **563,632,680 defined roles in the entire organization**, including the original 10 directors, 20 independent assistants, 150 managers, 7,500 workers and 1,125,000 subagents. Every micro-worker has a unique stable ID of the form `D01-M01-W01-S001-G001`, a distinct research assignment among 500 templates, and **exactly one boss: its named S-level subagent**. No extra boss is created by cross-company research evidence sharing.

**To all managers and directors:** Every role understands the exact owner's overriding objective—**legitimately earned transferable cryptocurrency independently verified as received at an owner-approved correct-network address**. Discover real BTC, genuine USDC or other specifically approved coin-paying tasks, check payer/fees/eligibility/asset/network, prepare courteous offers, and pass source-linked leads. Fiat-only income, vanity agent counts, unclaimed rewards, testnet/demo coins, unverified deposits and messages are **not** success.

**Independence:** Research workers may choose how to investigate, challenge poor leads, reject scams, suggest improvements and report upward. D09 checks payout authenticity. D10 checks actual inference outputs and independently confirmed receipts. No exposed private accounts, passwords, wallet signing, payments, impersonation, external mass messaging or unauthorized creation of separate online accounts.

**Operational truth:** These are **deterministic software-role definitions**, not 562,500,000 concurrently running models, human employees or independently registered AI social accounts. A bounded code path may run **one separate inference per activated microcompany boss per actual cloud cycle**; only saved successful model-call reports count as active AI. Never invent activity or coins.
